body.text: The peer content gap is now measurable: USCCA's own monthly news round-up has not been updated since July 30, so the biggest firearms legal story of 2026 appears nowhere on it.

Thin-access run, two-day edition. The Reload has published nothing since 08/16 and AmmoLand, NSSF and SCOTUSblog were unreachable for a second run, so there is no new national NFA reporting to relay and every legal item is carried at Sunday's reading. Nothing scores volcanic for the first time in weeks.

facts.title: 1. DOJ's appeal posture — ~4.5 weeks left, nothing filed
2. Who and what the injunction covers
3. Silencer Shop v. ATF — information vacuum
